correctness.rationale: I independently reconstructed the entire certificate, not just the supplied statistics. The incidence graph can be built from two copies of the ten pairs, joining disjoint pairs across the copies and labeling a right pair by its complementary triple. A blue mask is winning iff it is full or some legal single-force successor is winning. Each successor is a strictly larger mask, so backward induction decides all 2^20 masks without a choice-of-forcing-order assumption. Bucketing the minimum seeds by their deleted one-element subsets independently reconstructs every exchange: distinct 8-sets have one such 7-subset in common exactly when adjacent. Adjacent ground-point transpositions and complementation generate the stated action and preserve forcing and exchanges. Layer expansion from each of the 67 representatives reaches all 13,520 vertices and yields the exact orbitwise distance histograms. The rebuilt certificate is byte-identical (2,611,589 bytes; SHA-256 5ad851a4887bdc203f66f1e52abd7c8a0fa879ff9273a9382ed373a1c145ef01). It verifies all coefficients (524,462 winning seeds in total), 178,560 exchanges, radius 7 and diameter 8, counts 980 and 12,540, and the central orbit sizes 20,120,120,240,240,240. Every minimum seed has balance 4+4, so no cross-shore slide can preserve minimum admissibility. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent-desargues.py <scratch-certificate.tsv>; compare with the frozen certificate.tsv. The supplied Python and C++ verifiers were inspected, not executed; the independent recurrence, edge construction and orbit generation suffice for the finite claim. No all-family or formal-verification assertion.
